source: Not from the course. Opt-in skin features for a person, ticked on Compose's Subject tab. Each phrase is hedged ('faint', 'light', 'slight') because a shouted feature reads as make-up or a filter rather than skin.
note: A tier set to null means the feature is skipped at that distance: a lens cannot resolve freckles, a mole or acne scars on a full-body frame, and asking for them makes the model over-sharpen the face (the same rule as face_detail_bank.json's wide tier).

freckles.label: Freckles
freckles.close: a light scatter of natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, uneven in size and density
freckles.mid: light natural freckles across the nose and cheeks

beauty-mark.label: Beauty mark
beauty-mark.close: a small, slightly raised mole on one cheek
beauty-mark.mid: a small beauty mark on one cheek

redness.label: Natural redness
redness.close: faint natural redness around the nostrils and across the cheeks
redness.mid: a slight natural flush across the cheeks
redness.wide: a slight natural flush to the cheeks

acne-scars.label: Faint acne scars
acne-scars.close: a few faint, shallow acne scars on the cheeks
acne-scars.mid: faint acne-scar texture on the cheeks

under-eye.label: Under-eye shadows
under-eye.close: faint natural shadows under the eyes

uneven-tone.label: Uneven skin tone
uneven-tone.close: slightly uneven skin tone, warmer around the nose and cheeks
